verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents identifying gaps and readiness status by mapping controls to CMMC requirements. It also documents per-framework control mapping with automated control testing, plus continuous daily monitoring of compliance status with failing-test alerts. That covers the core of a framework readiness view, but explicit gap and readiness status is only documented for CMMC. missing for 10: a documented single readiness percentage per framework, explicit gap and readiness views for frameworks beyond CMMC, a breakdown of passing controls versus remaining work, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, a readiness view shows exactly how far I am from audit-ready per framework — passing controls, open gaps, and what's left, as one honest percentage

citations.quote: Map controls to CMMC requirements automatically to identify gaps and readiness status
Each supported framework includes control mapping to framework requirements, automated control testing that collects compliance evidence from integrated technologies
Continuous daily monitoring of your compliance status with alerts for failing tests.
Customers can quickly see failing tests, overdue tasks, mentions, audit activity, vendor updates, and other items that require attention.
